description.fr-FR: Les lettres de direction de Fénelon, telles que les range l’édition Saint-Sulpice (section « Lettres spirituelles » de la Correspondance) : à l’électeur de Cologne, à Mme de Maintenon, à des religieuses, à des personnes du monde, à la comtesse de Montberon et à d’autres. Texte de l’édition de 1851 (en français) ; la sélection anglaise de Lear est un livre à part.
description.en-US: Fénelon’s letters of spiritual direction as the Saint-Sulpice edition arranges them (the “Lettres spirituelles” section of the Correspondence): to the Elector of Cologne, to Mme de Maintenon, to nuns, to people of the world, to the Countess of Montberon and others. The text is the 1851 edition in French; Lear’s English selection is a separate book.
description.pt-BR: As cartas de direção de Fénelon, na ordem da edição de Saint-Sulpice (seção «Lettres spirituelles» da Correspondência): ao eleitor de Colônia, à sra. de Maintenon, a religiosas, a pessoas do mundo, à condessa de Montberon e a outros.

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 8, p. 439–720; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md). Many letter headings and numerals are lost in the OCR, so the letters are grouped by addressee in parts of about 7,500 words; the letter numbers in the ## subheads are ours.
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
